method: MIXED. S1 is the OPEN RACGP AJGP article 'Chest pain' (July 2024), retrieved as HTML, tag-stripped and QUOTED VERBATIM: every S1 claim carries source_text re-checked here against the retrieved file, so all of it is machine re-checkable. A1-A11 are eleven AMH pages read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage is stored, every claim carries its page's locator and the verdict licensed_source_not_quoted, and NONE of it is machine re-checkable. The division of labour is not accidental -- the open source covers ASSESSMENT of chest pain and carries none of the antianginal doses, so EVERY DOSE IN THIS GUIDELINE IS LICENSED AND UNQUOTED. S1 is a chest-pain article, not an angina management article; it is used for assessment, diagnosis and the differential, and is NOT used for drug choice.
